text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert fired: `model-serving-95th-latency` (pd/INC-2026-315) — threshold 95th > 300ms on us-west-2/gpu-pool-2

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident created: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-2026-315 :link:

maya: Acked. I'm on it — pinging runtime oncall.

alex: seeing a short spike in tail latency across two nodes in gpu-pool-2, starts ~3187654310, peaks ~3187654335, then drops. No 5xxs.

chen: metrics look like: continuous-batching queue depth jumped for ~40s. CPU on the nodes stayed normal, GPU utilization dropped briefly. suspect fast scale-down then cold KV warmup.

sam: any customer-reported errors from support?

maya: checking support queue... nothing flagged. no SLO burn on error budget dashboards. Looks like latency-only.

incident-bot: Auto-resolve: alert cleared after 65s (reason: metric returned below threshold). :white_check_mark:

alex: it auto-resolved but I see a follow-up spike 90s later that re-fired the same alert, probably another scale event.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation: second page sent to rotation (sam).

sam: oncall ack. jumping in. any quick mitigations?

maya: I temporarily bumped min-replicas on gpu-pool-2 to 2 -> 4 via infra-tool to reduce churn, will roll back after observation. command used:

```
infra-tool pool update --name gpu-pool-2 --min-replicas 4 --reason "transient autoscaler churn causing KV coldstarts"
```

chen: thanks. opening a follow-up ticket to tune scaler cooldown and KV pre-warm: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-9132

alex: proposal: increase cooldown to 120s and add a short KV pre-warm hook on scale-up. I can PR a change to autoscaler config.

sam: monitoring graphs now. tail latency back to baseline ~45s after the change. keeping suppression window 10m for this alert to avoid flapping noise.

maya: support confirmed no customer incidents. only internal SLO blip; 95th crossed threshold but P95 error budget unaffected.

chen: created PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/autoscaler/pull/598 — adds prewarm and longer cooldown for GPU pools.

sam: leaving note for next rotation: if this repeats after PR is deployed, escalate to infra-eng and consider static min capacity for popular models.

maya: handing off fully to sam for next 45m while I switch to deploy patch review.

sam: ack, will watch for 30m. if repeated >3 times in 1h we escalate.

incident-bot: Thread closed (auto-resolve window observed, suppression applied). :lock:

maya: summary: transient autoscaler churn in us-west-2 caused short KV coldstarts and brief P95 latency spikes. No customer errors, alert auto-resolved twice, temporary mitigation applied (min-replicas bump), follow-up PR opened to tune autoscaler. Owners: eng-runtime (alex, chen).

sam: adding a short postmortem note in the incidents tracker and tagging eng-runtime owners. :eyes:
